sources.title: Kalista Build Guide: The Spear of Vengeance | An in-depth Kalista Guide!
Kalista Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.text: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

spells.name: Pierce
spells.text: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

spells.name: Sentinel
spells.text: Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target. Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

spells.name: Rend
spells.text: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

spells.name: Fate's Call
spells.text: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

damage.value: Kalista deals sustained on-hit and Rend damage rather than relying on a single burst.

archetype.value: Kalista is a mobile ADC duelist who uses Martial Poise hops and Rend stacking.

axis.value: Kalista can poke with Pierce from 1150 range before committing to repeated attacks.

winCondition.value: Kalista wins through practiced positioning, Rend timing, and teamfight target selection.

spikes.why: Kalista's Martial Poise lunge distance scales with Boots tier.

spikes.at: When Kalista has impaled a target with more spears

bait.why: After Kalista uses Pierce, its nine-second cooldown leaves her without that long-range spear.
After Kalista uses Fate’s Call, its long cooldown leaves her without its teleport and knockback setup.

mistakes.value: Kalista loses outplay opportunities when her positioning or Rend timing is careless.
